DREAD.RUINA2-FAIRY.description: When an enemy falls below [blue]50%[/blue] HP, it gains [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DREAD.RUINA2-BLACK_SWAN.description: All enemies start with [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of their first turn.
DREAD.RUINA2-ORCHESTRA.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Second Chair[/gold] and [gold]Third Chair[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DREAD.RUINA2-NOTHING_DER.description: At the end of your first turn, you take [blue]7[/blue] damage.
DREAD.RUINA2-JESTER.description: At the start of each combat, you lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DREAD.RUINA2-OZ.description: At the start of each combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] [gold]False Gifts[/gold] to accept.
DREAD.RUINA2-TWILIGHT.description: At the start of your turn, shuffle [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dazzled[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DREAD.RUINA2-SILENT_GIRL.description: At the start of each combat, you gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Nails[/gold]. All enemies gain [gold]Painful Stabs[/gold].
DREAD.RUINA2-ARGALIA.description: At the start of your turn, you gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vibration[/gold] and shuffle [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Controlled Vibration[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
